text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through the training camp lodge 
after finishing a day's training with 
Oguri Cap—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Oguri's Trainer, I need 
a word with ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri was still running outside just now, 
was that your idea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap should have already finished 
today's training. I told her to get plenty 
of rest before we parted ways, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
From that reaction, guess not. Good grief, 
that Oguri...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ever since running against Creek, she's 
been acting strange the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't ya go take a look? She was down 
on the beach!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief, both Creek and Oguri. Look 
at 'em, all youthful and whatnot.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry 'bout it, really! Hurry up 
and go catch up with Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thanked Tamamo Cross and hurried down to 
the sandy beach...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... ...One more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why did she continue training on her own? 
Searching for words, Oguri Cap slowly 
began to explain the reason to me—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...We ran on the beach with Creek before, 
right? Back then... I felt just a little 
bit confident."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I had been feeling great lately, and I 
believed that with my heart, 2000 meters 
wouldn't be a problem... or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There was no reason for me to lose to 
Creek. And yet, in reality...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...That may be what the results say, but 
the truth is different. I was the one... 
who lost.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If there were another 500 meters... I 
would have been overtaken for sure.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—The Arima Kinen is 2,500 meters. If that 
had been the real race...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't build more stamina, I'll never 
beat Creek. Before I knew it, that thought 
brought me right here..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. I should have talked to 
you first."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yet, for some reason, I just couldn't sit 
still. I had to run more—that was the only 
thing on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just didn't want to lose to Creek... 
That was all it was.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Rivals...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I don't want to lose... to my 
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she was able to face Super Creek 
during this training camp. It lit a fire 
under Oguri Cap's fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's not all. We also saw the clear 
results of all the hard work Oguri Cap has 
put in up until now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh...
choice_data_list:
Once they drew alongside, she never gave 
up the lead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was certainly a difference in 
stamina. Yet even after being pulled 
alongside, Oguri Cap clung on with sheer 
desperation.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That was... ...because I heard a voice.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama, Inari... I heard your voices. And 
when I thought about how I had to win...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Growing stronger by the amount of cheers 
received. That, too, is the strength of 
Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And now that she has built up a track 
record... the cheers she receives at the 
Arima Kinen will surely be on a whole 
other level!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! I see... So you truly believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Your words always put me at 
ease, after all...
choice_data_list:
Let's not rush—let's keep moving forward 
steadily.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right... I won't act selfishly 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So tell me, Trainer. What should I do 
right now?
choice_data_list: Let's build up even more power!
Let's make sure we don't lose heart!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Power, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you build up power, you'll be able to 
muster one last push even when your 
stamina is drained.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Let's focus on strength 
training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Feelings, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you build the guts to push yourself 
that one extra step, it will surely serve 
you well in races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Understood. Let's stay strong.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Jeez, what're you two 
doing?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What d'you mean "what's wrong"?! Neither 
of you were comin' back at all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I figured her Trainer would take her 
right back, so why'm I the dummy stuck 
waiting around at the front door?!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see, so Tama brought the Trainer... 
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's not like that, I just happened to 
spot you and called out! ...So, did you 
solve your problem?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm alright. I will... do my best.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then it's fine. Man, you really are a 
handful.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...And yet she's crazy fast. Talk about 
totally unfair.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, it's nothin'! C'mon, we're gonna 
eat, right? Let's head back!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, why are ya leavin' me behind?! 
Heyyy, wait up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Oguri Cap grew tremendously over 
the course of the training camp.
